title: 第42章 活捉獐子

第42章 活捉獐子-《赶山1957：二斤猪肉换个媳妇》

李青山发现，出现野兔野鸡这一类东西的时候，玉葫芦发热的温较小，但是出现獐子的时候，热量就更高一些，当初发现狍子的时候，玉葫芦发热的热量更高。

看来这玉葫芦的警示作用还会因为猎物的大小出现变化，日后若是出现老虎或者黑熊的话，想必也能够根据这玉葫芦有一定的判断。

不对，当初出现野狼的时候，李青山记得玉葫芦是发凉的，等到下一次再遇到野狼，黑熊这一类有危险的猎物时，再研究一下这玉葫芦吧！

这小小的玉葫芦，其中还有许多奥秘自己未曾探索！

李青山立刻朝着同伴压了压手，旋即将背后的长弓取了下来，站在旁边的大壮也第一时间看到了小溪边的獐子，小声道：“山哥，咱们运气不错啊，又遇到一只狍子？”

“狍子？”

“这可不是狍子。”

李青山笑了笑道。

大壮，赵红旗这些人，虽然都住在老林子旁边，但是你让他们认识一些普通的野物他们认识，但是遇到狍子，獐子，香獐子这些东西的时候，就有些难以认清了。

比如说大家最常见，也是名气最大的果子狸，就和猪獾，狗獾，鼬獾，貘一样，一些老人都不一定能分得清楚，毕竟这东西也不是很常见，远远没有各种野鸡和野兔普及的多。

狍子，獐子，香獐子，这三种狍子是最大的，香獐子第二，獐子是最小的，狍子是最好被区分的，就是臀部的毛是白色的，但是獐子和香獐子就难以区分了，而且这两种还不是一个品种。

獐子是鹿科动物，但是香獐子是麝科动物！

雄性香獐子倒也好区分，就是有个麝香腺，獐子是没有的，雌性的香獐子和獐子最难区分，只有两个地方稍微有些不同，一个是颜色，獐子是黄褐色，香獐子是深棕色，也就是香獐子更显得红一些，香獐子的脖颈有浅纹，而獐子却没有。

獐子的体重一般都是在三十斤。

眼前这只獐子稍微小一些，但也不会小到哪里去。

“山哥，这不是狍子是什么？”大壮微微一怔，脸上流露出一抹疑惑和诧异之色问道。

“獐子！”李青山道。

“獐子？听说獐子身上有麝香，那玩意挺贵的，堪比黄金呢！”赵红旗脸上升起一抹惊喜道。

“这是獐子，你说那个叫香獐子！”

“你们三个准备好，这次我不打算直接射脖子，要是一箭射不死的话，你们就冲上去抓住！”李青山拉满长弓瞄准道。

“啥？”

"这么远，还能想要射哪里便射哪里不成？"

赵红旗一脸惊讶道。

Li Qingshan discovered that when things like hares and pheasants appear, the jade gourd generates less heat, but when roe deer appears, the heat is higher. When the roe deer was first discovered, the heat of the jade gourd was higher.

It seems that the warning effect of this jade gourd will also change depending on the size of the prey. If a tiger or black bear appears in the future, I will be able to make a certain judgment based on this jade gourd.

No, when the wild wolves first appeared, Li Qingshan remembered that the jade gourd was cold. Wait until the next time he encounters dangerous prey such as wild wolves and black bears, and then study this jade gourd!

There are many mysteries in this little jade gourd that I have not yet explored!

Li Qingshan immediately pressed his hand towards his companion, and immediately took off the long bow from his back. Da Zhuang, who was standing next to him, immediately saw the deer by the stream and whispered: "Brother Shan, we are very lucky. We met another deer?"

"Roe deer?"

"This is not a roe deer."

Li Qingshan smiled and said.

Although people like Da Zhuang and Zhao Hongqi all live next to the old forest, if you let them know some common wild animals, they will recognize them, but when they encounter things like roe deer, deer deer, and fragrant deer, it is a little difficult to recognize them.

For example, the most common and famous civet is just like the pig badger, dog badger, ferret badger, and tapir. Some old people may not be able to tell the difference clearly. After all, this thing is not very common, and it is far less popular than various pheasants and hares.

Roe deer, deer deer, and fragrant deer deer are the largest, fragrant deer deer is the second, and deer deer is the smallest. Roe deer is the best to distinguish, that is, the hair on the buttocks is white, but it is difficult to distinguish between deer deer and fragrant deer deer, and the two are not the same species.

The deer deer is a deer, but the fragrant deer is a musk deer!

The male deer deer is easy to distinguish, but it has a musk gland, which the deer deer does not have. The female deer deer is the most difficult to distinguish from the deer deer. There are only two slight differences. One is the color, the deer deer is yellowish brown, the deer deer is dark brown, that is, the fragrant deer deer looks redder. The neck of the fragrant deer deer has light lines, but the deer deer does not.

The weight of deer deer is generally thirty kilograms.

The deer in front of me is slightly smaller, but not too small.

"Brother Shan, what is this if it's not a roe deer?" Da Zhuang was slightly startled and asked with a look of doubt and surprise on his face.

"Deer!" Li Qingshan said.

"Deer deer? I heard that deer deer have musk on them. That thing is quite expensive, as good as gold!" Zhao Hongqi said with a hint of surprise on his face.

"This is the deer, you said that one is called the fragrant deer!"

"You three, get ready. I don't plan to shoot him directly in the neck this time. If he can't be killed with one arrow, you can rush forward and catch him!" Li Qingshan drew his long bow and took aim.

"What?"

"It's so far away, how can you shoot wherever you want?"

Zhao Hongqi said with a surprised look.
